messages:
michelle_pm: Quick thread to settle pilot scope for the Optimize toolkit feature we've been iterating on. Customer wants per-route recommendations (batching, kv cache, quant) + eval-triggered alerts + safe auto-fallback. We need a minimal, testable pilot. Thoughts?

rahul_eng: Minimal pilot proposal: adaptive batching (route-specific presets), per-route KV caching with TTL, int8 recommend only. No int4, no automatic global tuning. Feature-flag per-customer and per-route.

michelle_pm: Agree keep it narrow. ACME cares about chat p99 < 120ms and a background summarizer throughput target. They will provide sample corpora per-route.

jenna_product: Launch gates idea: (1) staging soak 72h with p99 target for chat; (2) eval alert simulation: synthetic regressions cause expected alerts; (3) per-customer canary toggle + revert; (4) docs + sample SDK call.

alex_cs: ACME also wants an "approve" button in Console for any recommended change and an audit log of applied configs + revert API. They prefer manual apply for recommendations in pilot.

sara_ml: Eval hooks: offline baseline vs applied-config on their corpus. Alert rule prototype: relative_drop(metric) > 0.02 AND abs_drop > 0.005 -> trigger "optimize_quality_regress". On alert: sample 100% for 30m and route traffic to FP fallback for that customer if manual fallback enabled.

luis_research: For recommendations we can start with heuristics: route_type -> {chat: batch_max 8, max_wait 15ms, cache_pref high; batch: batch_max 64, max_wait 150ms, cache_pref medium}. Show estimated perf delta and estimated quality delta with explanation.

rahul_eng: Runtime pilot snippet:```yaml
optimize_toolkit:
  enabled: true
  per_customer_flags: true
  recommend_quant: int8
  routes:
    - name: chat
      adaptive_batching: true
      max_wait_ms: 15
      max_batch_size: 8
      cache_ttl_ms: 60000
    - name: summarization
      adaptive_batching: true
      max_wait_ms: 150
      max_batch_size: 64
      cache_ttl_ms: 300000
  eval_alerts:
    rel_drop_threshold: 0.02
    abs_min_delta: 0.005
    sample_on_alert_duration_min: 30
```

tim_sre: Ops requirements: canary rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%), global kill-switch, metrics exposed in Console: batch_size_hist, cache_hit_rate, p50/p95/p99 by route, applied_recs_count, revert_count, eval_alert_count. Add circuit-breaker: disable adaptive batching if error rate increases > X.

michelle_pm: Decision check: int8 only for pilot? anyone object?

luis_research: No objections. int8 keeps noise low and is explainable with eval numbers.

alex_cs: ACME ok with int8 only.

jenna_product: Prioritization: pilot-tier. Proposed timeline: 2 sprints. Sprint A = heuristics recommender, console mockups, per-route flags. Sprint B = offline eval hooks, alerting, manual apply & revert, staging soak.

michelle_pm: Risks: PII in sampled inputs -> must run obfuscation; quantized outputs might have subtle semantic drift -> ensure eval uses both n-gram and embedding similarity metrics.

ci-bot (ops-bot): CI: feature/optimize-lite -> staging (#8200) queued

rahul_eng: Action items: rahul - implement runtime knobs + perf bench; sara - wire eval runner + alert rules; tim - canary controls + circuit-breaker; jenna - PRD + console mockups + audit spec; alex - collect ACME corpora and consent for sampling; luis - write recommended heuristics explanation text for UI. Reply here when done.

michelle_pm: I'll consolidate into PRD after updates. Thanks all, closing thread for decisions.
